--	Previous Business Day

UPDATE SND.DATE_DIM
SET Previous_Business_Day = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Previous_Business_Date AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM (
		SELECT DateSK
			, Business_Day_Flag
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
				Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND 1 Preceding) Previous_Business_Date                     
		FROM SND.DATE_DIM
		WHERE YEAR(CAST(fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
    ) AS Business_Day
WHERE DATE_DIM.DateSK = Business_Day.DateSK AND YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Week

UPDATE SND.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Week = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Previous_Business_Week AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
   (
		SELECT DateSK
			, Business_Day_Flag
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND 7 Preceding) Previous_Business_Week                     
		FROM SND.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(CAST(fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
   ) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.DateSK = Business_Day.DateSK AND YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Month

UPDATE SND.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Month = DATEADD(month, -1, CAST(fulldate AS DATE))
WHERE --Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' AND --remove by TRD 7/30
YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);
               
UPDATE SND.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Month = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Latest_Business_Day AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
	(
		SELECT DateSK
			, CAST(fulldate AS DATE) AS FULLDATE
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND CURRENT ROW) Latest_Business_Day
		FROM SND.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(CAST(fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
	) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Previous_Month = CAST(Business_Day.fulldate AS DATE) AND YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Quarter

UPDATE SND.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Quarter = DATEADD(month, -3, CAST(fulldate AS DATE))
WHERE --Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' AND --remove by TRD 7/30
YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);
               
UPDATE SND.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Quarter = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Latest_Business_Day AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
	(
		SELECT DateSK
			, CAST(fulldate AS DATE) AS FULLDATE
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND CURRENT ROW) Latest_Business_Day
		FROM SND.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(CAST(fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
	) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Previous_Quarter = CAST(Business_Day.fulldate AS DATE) AND YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Year

UPDATE SND.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Year = DATEADD(month, -12, CAST(fulldate AS DATE))
WHERE --Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' AND --remove by TRD 7/30
YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);
               
UPDATE SND.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Year = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Latest_Business_Day AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
	(
		SELECT DateSK
			, CAST(fulldate AS DATE) AS FULLDATE
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND CURRENT ROW) Latest_Business_Day
		FROM SND.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(CAST(fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
	) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Previous_Year = CAST(Business_Day.fulldate AS DATE) AND YEAR(CAST(DATE_DIM.fulldate AS DATE)) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	*****

WITH PREV_WEEK AS (
SELECT YEAR,WEEKOFYEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM SND.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y' AND YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2022','2023','2024')
GROUP BY
YEAR,WEEKOFYEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
),
PREV_MONTH AS (
SELECT YEAR,MONTH,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM SND.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y' AND YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2022','2023','2024')
GROUP BY
YEAR,MONTH,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
),
PREV_YEAR AS (
SELECT YEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM SND.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y' AND YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2022','2023','2024')
GROUP BY
YEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
)
UPDATE DD
SET Previous_Week_Last_Bus_Day = (CONVERT(VARCHAR,COALESCE(PW.LATEST_BDATE,PM.LATEST_BDATE,PY.LATEST_BDATE))) ,
Previous_Month_Last_Bus_Day = (CONVERT(VARCHAR,COALESCE(PM.LATEST_BDATE,PY.LATEST_BDATE))), 
Previous_Year_Last_Bus_Day = (CONVERT(VARCHAR,PY.LATEST_BDATE)) 

FROM SND.DATE_DIM DD 
LEFT JOIN PREV_WEEK PW
ON (DATEPART(WEEK,CAST(DD.FULLDATE AS DATE))-1)=PW.WEEKOFYEAR AND PW.YEAR=DD.YEAR
LEFT JOIN PREV_MONTH PM
ON (DATEPART(MONTH,CAST(DD.FULLDATE AS DATE))-1)=PM.MONTH AND PM.YEAR=DD.YEAR
LEFT JOIN PREV_YEAR PY
ON (DATEPART(YEAR,CAST(DD.FULLDATE AS DATE))-1)=PY.YEAR 
WHERE DD.YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2023','2024');


INITIAL UPDATE MONTH_END
UPDATE SND.DATE_DIM
SET MONTH_END = 'N'
WHERE YEAR BETWEEN  YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--UPDATE MONTH_END
UPDATE A
SET MONTH_END = 'Y'
FROM SND.DATE_DIM A
JOIN (SELECT CAST(fulldate AS DATE) AS FULLDATE,DATESK,YYYYMM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY YYYYMM ORDER BY DATESK DESC) RN FROM SND.DATE_DIM WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) AND BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' ) B
    ON A.DATESK = B.DATESK AND B.RN = 1 AND A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR,YEAR) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);



--INITIAL UPDATE CURRENT_MONTH_END
UPDATE SND.DATE_DIM
SET CURRENT_MONTH_END = NULL
WHERE YEAR BETWEEN  YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);


--UPDATE CURRENT_MONTH_END
UPDATE A
SET CURRENT_MONTH_END = CAST(B.FULLDATE AS DATE)
FROM SND.DATE_DIM A
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATESK,CAST(fulldate AS DATE) AS FULLDATE,CURRENT_MONTH_END,MONTH FROM SND.DATE_DIM WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) AND MONTH_END = 'Y') B
    ON A.MONTH = B.MONTH
WHERE YEAR BETWEEN  YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);
